# The Docker Hub images CI runs, each pinned to the digest its tag resolved to when it was written
# here (#980). One line per image: `<name>:<tag> <digest>`, the tag kept for the human reading it.
# Read by db-matrix in ci.yml (its leg's line) and by docker-smoke.yml (every line), both through
# pull-pinned.sh, so the two jobs cannot pin the same tag to different bytes.
#
# No Dependabot ecosystem reads this file, so a digest here moves only by hand. To refresh one:
#   docker buildx imagetools inspect docker.io/library/<name>:<tag>
# and copy the « Digest: » it prints (the index digest, which covers every platform).
